verdict.summary: Corn-on-the-cob is generally safe for individuals with coeliac disease as corn itself is gluten-free. However, cross-contamination or added ingredients can pose risks.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
